tools.name: shorti_what_to_shoot
tools.description: Shorti(쇼티) for «what should I shoot this week?», «이번 주 뭐 찍지?», «find videos of…» or «… 영상 찾아줘». Today's rising hits and this week's formats, for a field, a product or any words, from the West, or by their taste. `about`: a field, product, niche or @handle (Korean initials work). `category` narrows i

tools.name: shorti_how_to_shoot
tools.description: Shorti(쇼티) for a TikTok, Reels or Shorts link with «how was this shot?», «이 영상 어떻게 찍었어?», «나도 이렇게 찍으려면?» or «분석해줘». One video or format as a creator shoots it. `url` or `video_id`: its hook, beats and numbers (not_in_corpus: not read yet). `format_id`: its plan and hits. `part`: plan (its format's),

tools.name: shorti_recipe
tools.description: Shorti(쇼티) for «how do I make this?» or «이거 어떻게 만들어?». A hit made their way: their clips to its clock, their AI video model or a 3D generator. `kind`: edit (their editor), remake (their video model: `mode`, `model`), scene (a 3D generator).

tools.name: shorti_make
tools.description: Shorti(쇼티) for «make my version of this» or «이걸로 내 버전 만들어줘». A person's own AI version of a hit made for them, its framing, light and sound kept, labelled AI. Keyless it starts nothing: it says what works today, the hit's page with its pencil and the way their own AI makes it free.

tools.name: shorti_arena
tools.description: Shorti(쇼티) for «what has nobody shot yet?» or «아직 아무도 안 찍은 거 뭐 있어?». The arena's open spots, first recorded takes, later breakouts and entrant standings. view='spots': open spots, their words, dates and how to shoot; 'board': first takes and finds; 'entrant': one entrant's standing. Unread: not_run,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shorti_how_to_shoot, shorti_check · Private data: shorti_check · Public sink: shorti_check · Destructive: shorti_how_to_shoot, shorti_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shorti_how_to_shoot, shorti_check · Private data: shorti_check · Public sink: shorti_check · Destructive: shorti_how_to_shoot, shorti_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
